a: He never wrote code and didn't own a computer until age 33

questions.q: What did Ma choose to see instead of his lack of knowledge?
a: A potential market of one billion customers
A path to a quick sale
questions.why: Lesson 1 says he saw a big potential market.

questions.q: What time horizon did Ma set for Alibaba?
questions.why: Lesson 2 says he wanted it around for 80 years, later raised to 102.

questions.q: What does lesson 2 call a common launch mistake?
questions.why: The lesson says one of the most common mistakes is the wrong time horizon.

a: By finding a key customer insight and building around it
